name: Blood of the Swift: Blink of an Eye

system.description: At the beginning of your turn, by spending 2 Speed Seals, you can select a space within your movement speed range and teleport to the chosen location. All hostile creatures whose space is adjacent to the space you teleport to must make a Dexterity saving throw, suffering a -2 penalty to their AC until the beginning of your next turn on a failed save due to the suddenness of your appearance. If you were to make an attack against a creature with a penalized AC during the same turn you teleport, you can choose to spend 1 additional Speed Seal to teleport back to the original space you started your turn in.
